title: New isTranscriptLoaded gate on the overview controller has no unit test
outcome: conversation-overview-controller.ts gained an isTranscriptLoaded prop that gates shouldRenderRail (so a tail-first hydrated session shows the is-pending skeleton instead of drawing its 20-message tail as the whole conversation). conversation-overview-controller.test.tsx was not touched, so the gate has no controller-level coverage: nothing asserts shouldRenderRail is false while isTranscriptLoaded is false but shouldRender/isRailReady/layoutSnapshot are all satisfied.
